neet_bio_u03_t08_1.working: Carboxypeptidase is a zinc-dependent metalloenzyme; Zn2+ is its cofactor.

neet_bio_u03_t08_3.working: Removing a group by a non-hydrolytic route and leaving a double bond is the defining action of lyases.

neet_bio_u03_t08_4.working: Low temperature only inactivates enzymes temporarily, and activity returns on warming, so A is false. Heat denatures enzyme proteins, so R is true.

neet_bio_u03_t08_5.working: Statement I has the definitions swapped: a prosthetic group is tightly bound, while a coenzyme binds only transiently, so I is incorrect. Haem is the prosthetic group of catalase, and NAD contains niacin, so II is correct.
